artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: THE INCOMPLETE-READ SIGNAL. `read_rank_series` read `Responses` from BatchGetItem and NOTHING ELSE, so keys returned in `UnprocessedKeys` were dropped on the floor: a partially-processed read produced a shorter series with no error, no completeness field and no retry, and was indistinguishable from a genuinely empty producer day. THREE THINGS ADDED. (1) A BOUNDED RETRY: `_BATCH_GET_MAX_ATTEMPTS` (default 4, env knob) re-asks the unprocessed keys per chunk and then STOPS, recording what remains -- never re-asking forever and never dropping. (2) `_read_completeness()`, a record carrying `complete` as a machine-rejectable token beside its DENOMINATOR (requested/resolved/unresolved key counts, attempts_used, max_attempts) and a `reason` that states in words that the missing points are NOT evidence the producer wrote nothing. (3) A PER-TICKER `unresolved_point_count` on every series entry, because a single global flag cannot tell a page WHICH line it may trust when some tickers are whole and others are short. THE SAME SHAPE ON BOTH RETURN PATHS, including the no-tickers early return: a completeness field present on one branch and absent on another teaches consumers to use .get() and treat missing as fine. NO SLEEP BETWEEN ATTEMPTS, AND THAT IS A DECISION RECORDED IN THE SOURCE, NOT AN OMISSION: this adapter sits behind an API Gateway HTTP API with a 29-second integration ceiling, so a backoff long enough to outlast real throttling converts a partial read the caller could have rendered into a 504 that tells it nothing.

NEW, 7 tests, one per required response shape plus three that guard the distinction itself. The fake is a SCRIPTED resource -- a test says 'unprocessed, then processed' and the adapter actually walks that path -- and it RECORDS EVERY CALL, because the original defect was invisible partly because the old fake recorded one call and nobody asserted on the count, so a missing retry looked exactly like a retry that was not needed. The four shapes: fully processed (complete, 1 call), genuinely absent (complete, zero points, 1 call -- a quiet day must NOT read as a broken read), partially processed (2 calls, attempts_used 2, complete, and the retried point collected), retry-exhausted (incomplete, denominator preserved, bounded at _BATCH_GET_MAX_ATTEMPTS). Plus the load-bearing one: shape 2 and shape 4 both yield ZERO points and must remain distinguishable on both `complete` and `unresolved_point_count`.
